fixtures: Contact/asset fixtures now move obligate swimmers to actual water and place the test player on a nearby legal surf/land tile. Species habitat availability and movement are independently checked by the nine-request geometry suite.
The child page is explicitly qa=1; execution requires qaMode=true, reset newSave, and isolated in-memory persistence supplied by Game.
Automatic gameplay simulation is paused with panel=qa-controller. The harness advances Game.step in 0.05-second increments; the actual renderer and UI loop remain active.
Encounter RNG results are seeded by setting capture.success after a real throw. Capture flight, transition, shakes, registration and cleanup still execute normally.
Progression counts/items/boss prerequisites are seeded to test each gate independently. Player level/HP and encounter positions are seeded to keep combat bounded.

The 151-species pass spawns each real model, casts its authored basic action, verifies damage, switches its real normal/shiny texture, and runs a physical capture. This is not natural acquisition-path playthrough evidence.
Capture UI is exercised before the bulk pass. Bulk capture previews are counted instead of opening 151 extra WebGL contexts; bulk core capture/registration and completion presentation still run.
No persistent browser storage or save export is used. Game-internal writes go only to the QA memory adapter.
